package.description: Desktop music search, playback, and download application.

en-US.description: Desktop music search, playback, and download application.
en-US.longDescription: iSpotify is a local-first desktop application for searching, playing, organizing, and downloading music.
en-US.name: iSpotify
en-US.releaseNotes:
Removes the hosted backend and performs searches and downloads directly from the desktop application.
Adds local YouTube cookie validation and a Settings page for sign-in and bot-check errors.
